VISION.TITLE: Our Vision
VISION.DESCRIPTION: To be the world's most trusted strategic brand builder — the partner that transforms ambitious brands into global category leaders.
VISION.DETAILED_DESCRIPTION:
Our focus is ambitious brands ready to own their category globally. We work with outstanding start-ups, mid-market challengers, and established players seeking new market entry — combining hands-on operational expertise with a proven global network.

From route-to-market strategy to full market restructuring, we deliver results others can't — because we've done it ourselves.
BENEFITS: Strategic brand building that turns ambitious brands into category leaders
Proven expertise scaling brands across 100+ countries
Senior-led, hands-on approach delivering measurable results

ABOUT_ROLE.TITLE: About Us & Our Role
ABOUT_ROLE.DESCRIPTION: TTA — The Turnaround Artists — is a global strategic brand builder headquartered in Dubai. We work with world-class brands to design, build, and scale their international distribution across the world.
ABOUT_ROLE.STATISTICS: We work with world-class brands across 100+ countries, supported by 80+ years of collective expertise in international expansion.
ABOUT_ROLE.DESCRIPTION_P2: Our senior team brings 80+ years of collective expertise spanning P&G, Coca-Cola, Redbull, and leading FMCG multinationals. We don't just place products in markets — we build the infrastructure, strategy, and partnerships that create sustainable global businesses.
ABOUT_ROLE.DESCRIPTION_P3: We are not a traditional distributor, and we are not a hands-off agency. We are a strategic brand broker — the partner that connects the world's best brands with the world's fastest-growing markets, and stays accountable for the result.

MISSION.TITLE: Our Mission
MISSION.DESCRIPTION: We architect global growth for outstanding brands — combining deep market intelligence, a 100+ country network, and 80+ years of collective expertise to deliver results that matter.
GOALS: Architect global growth strategies for outstanding brands
Combine deep market intelligence with a proven 100+ country network
Deliver senior-led results with skin in the game

CORE_PILLARS.TITLE: Our Core Pillars
CORE_PILLARS.DESCRIPTION: Global Intelligence, Local Mastery; Built for Scale, Designed to Last; and Aligned Incentives, Shared Success form the foundation of how we work.

PILLARS.TITLE: Global Intelligence, Local Mastery
PILLARS.SHORT_DESCRIPTION: Every country's market intelligence with deep local expertise — no guesswork.
PILLARS.DETAILED_DESCRIPTION: We combine every country's market intelligence with deep local expertise — knowing exactly which channels, partners, and strategies will accelerate your brand in each territory. No guesswork. Just proven playbooks adapted for your market.

PILLARS.TITLE: Built for Scale, Designed to Last
PILLARS.SHORT_DESCRIPTION: A model built to adapt — so your brand grows across cycles and conditions.
PILLARS.DETAILED_DESCRIPTION: Markets evolve. Consumer behaviour shifts. Regulations change. TTA's model is built to adapt — continuously optimising your distribution infrastructure so your brand grows consistently across economic cycles and market conditions.

PILLARS.TITLE: Aligned Incentives. Shared Success.
PILLARS.SHORT_DESCRIPTION: We only win when you win — aligned incentives and long-term trust.
PILLARS.DETAILED_DESCRIPTION: We only win when you win. TTA structures every partnership around aligned commercial incentives — ensuring profitability, transparency, and long-term trust at every level of the value chain. Your growth is our mandate.

STRATEGIC_REACH.TITLE: A Global Network Built Over Decades
STRATEGIC_REACH.DESCRIPTION:
TTA operates across 180+ countries — spanning GCC & Middle East, Africa, Asia Pacific, Europe, and the Americas. Our network of trusted distributors, regional partners, and in-market experts gives your brand immediate access to markets that would otherwise take years to enter alone.

We are your fastest route to global scale.

BUSINESS_MODEL.TITLE: How We Work
BUSINESS_MODEL.DESCRIPTION:
TTA operates as a full-service strategic distribution partner — not just a route-to-market facilitator. We design the architecture, select the partners, manage the relationships, and optimize performance across B2B, e-commerce, modern trade, and traditional retail channels.

Scalable. Efficient. Senior-led from day one.

CASE_STUDY_MEGA_PRIME.TITLE: Case Study: Mega Prime
CASE_STUDY_MEGA_PRIME.CHALLENGE: Mega Prime was primarily positioned as a regional brand in the Philippines, with limited international visibility.
CASE_STUDY_MEGA_PRIME.ACTION: TTA supported Mega Prime's preparation for international markets, guided the process toward MWA recognition, and repositioned the brand around universal values of quality, nutrition, and wellness — moving it beyond a single regional identity.
CASE_STUDY_MEGA_PRIME.RESULT: Mega Prime now sits within a strategically diversified brand portfolio, positioned across distinct categories to meet varying consumer preferences across markets.

WHY_DIFFERENT.TITLE: Why TTA Is Different
WHY_DIFFERENT.SUBTITLE: The Missing Category in Global Brand Distribution
WHY_DIFFERENT.INTRO: Most brands face a choice: hire an expensive in-house international team, or use a traditional distributor who treats your product as one of hundreds.
WHY_DIFFERENT.BROKER: We are a strategic brand broker — the senior, accountable partner who thinks like your CMO, executes like your sales director, and delivers like a business owner with skin in the game.
WHY_DIFFERENT.CLOSING: We own the outcome. Not just the order.

WHO_WE_ARE.TITLE: Who We Are
WHO_WE_ARE.DESCRIPTION: TTA is led by experienced professionals with decades of hands-on expertise turning businesses into sustainable profit engines:

TEAM_PREVIEW.DESCRIPTION: TTA is led by experienced professionals with decades of hands-on expertise turning businesses into sustainable profit engines:

TEAM_MEMBERS.NAME: Nedal AlZatari
TEAM_MEMBERS.TITLE: Managing Partner
TEAM_MEMBERS.SHORT_BIO: With over three decades of experience driving business growth and strategy across multiple sectors, specializing in building sustainable, high-performing commercial organizations.
TEAM_MEMBERS.FULL_BIO: With over three decades of experience driving business growth and strategy across multiple sectors, I specialize in building sustainable, high-performing commercial organizations. My expertise spans energy, finance, marketing, sales, digital transformation, and e-commerce, enabling me to design and execute long-term business strategies that deliver consistent revenue and profit growth. As Chief Commercial Officer at Fine Hygienic Holding, I lead diverse business channels across 35+ countries and seven clusters, managing modern trade, traditional trade, HORECA, and distributor markets. I work closely with investors to identify merger and acquisition opportunities, driving double-digit annual growth while fostering a culture of sustainability, innovation, and excellence. A firm believer in continuous learning and empowerment, I'm passionate about creating agile, forward-thinking FMCG organizations through optimized strategies and digital innovation. I aim to build thriving business ecosystems that generate lasting value and impact across global markets.

TEAM_MEMBERS.NAME: James Michael Lafferty
TEAM_MEMBERS.TITLE: Managing Partner
TEAM_MEMBERS.SHORT_BIO: Chief Executive Officer of Fine Hygienic Holding and one of the most dynamic and multifaceted CEOs in the world, with nearly 40 years of global experience.
TEAM_MEMBERS.FULL_BIO: James Michael Lafferty is the Chief Executive Officer of Fine Hygienic Holding (FHH) and one of the most dynamic and multifaceted CEOs in the world. With nearly 40 years of global experience, he has led top FMCG companies including Procter & Gamble, Coca-Cola, and British American Tobacco across five continents. Beyond his corporate achievements, James is an Olympic coach, award-winning journalist, college professor, and world champion athlete. He has coached national and Olympic-level athletes, most notably guiding pole-vaulter EJ Obiena to a world #2 ranking and a 4th place finish at the 2024 Paris Olympics. A passionate advocate for wellness and leadership, James has been recognized globally — named CEO of the Year by both the Burj CEO Awards and the GCC Best Employer Awards, and listed multiple times by Forbes Middle East among the region's Top 100 CEOs.

TEAM_MEMBERS.NAME: Ruslan Humbatov
TEAM_MEMBERS.TITLE: Executive Leader
TEAM_MEMBERS.SHORT_BIO: Dynamic and results-driven Executive Leader with over 16 years of progressive leadership experience in the FMCG industry across the Türkiye, CIS region coupled global projects.
TEAM_MEMBERS.FULL_BIO: Dynamic and results-driven Executive Leader with over 16 years of progressive leadership experience in the FMCG industry across the Türkiye, CIS region coupled global projects. Proven track record in Distributor network management, Market entry and expansion, Strategic planning and execution, Capability building: Established Data & Analytics Centers and conducted high-impact training programs as a P&G Certified Trainer, contributing to the development of talent within and beyond the organization, Leadership and influence: Combining strong commercial acumen with hands-on operational expertise, I bring a passion for delivering value, developing people, and building high-performing teams in complex and evolving markets

TEAM_MEMBERS.NAME: Ahmad Al Awamleh
TEAM_MEMBERS.TITLE: Business Development Manager
TEAM_MEMBERS.SHORT_BIO: Engineer and business strategist with over 12 years of experience driving brand expansion, operational excellence, and revenue growth across multiple regions.
TEAM_MEMBERS.FULL_BIO: Engineer and business strategist with over 12 years of experience driving brand expansion, operational excellence, and revenue growth across multiple regions. Known for a data-driven approach and strong leadership in optimizing quality, compliance, and performance, with successful partnerships with global names such as Red Bull and Floward, contributing to increased market share and customer satisfaction. Skilled in building scalable systems, improving efficiency, and developing strategies that align innovation with commercial success. Passionate about continuous improvement and sustainable growth, with a focus on delivering measurable results that enhance brand reputation, strengthen operations, and ensure long-term profitability.

TEAM_MEMBERS.NAME: Nenad Nikolovski
TEAM_MEMBERS.TITLE: Executive Leader
TEAM_MEMBERS.SHORT_BIO: Executive leader with 25+ years of international experience in sales, general management, and business transformation across FMCG, distribution, and manufacturing sectors.
TEAM_MEMBERS.FULL_BIO: Executive leader with 25+ years of international experience in sales, general management, and business transformation across FMCG, distribution, and manufacturing sectors. Proven track record of delivering sustainable growth, leading complex turnarounds, and building high-performing organizations across South East Europe and broader international markets. Inspiring trust, passionate about people and business development.

TEAM_MEMBERS.NAME: Mohsin Ali
TEAM_MEMBERS.TITLE: Canadian Commercial Lead
TEAM_MEMBERS.SHORT_BIO: Results-driven CPG commercial leader with 20+ years at Reckitt, Kraft, and Colgate, building and launching brands across North America, Asia, GCC and African markets.
TEAM_MEMBERS.FULL_BIO: Mohsin Ali is the Canadian Commercial lead at TTA, with over two decades of brand building, new market launches, and commercial P&L ownership across Reckitt, Kraft, Colgate, and growth stage startups and scaleups. He has held local, regional, and global roles across strategy, commercial, brand, and innovation, launching 100+ products across new markets. His expertise covers the full commercial cycle from market entry strategy and pricing to brand building, trade activation and in-store execution. Beyond his corporate career, Mohsin founded two startups and partnered with multiple early stage and high growth startups, accelerating market entry, traction and revenue growth. With a deep understanding of how to build brands from zero in new markets, Mohsin brings the experience and drive needed to open and grow TTA's Canada territory.

TEAM_MEMBERS.NAME: Andrey Grigoriev
TEAM_MEMBERS.TITLE: Executive Leader
TEAM_MEMBERS.SHORT_BIO: Senior commercial professional with 25 years of delivering profitable growth and developing capabilities across major multinationals and mid-sized private companies.
TEAM_MEMBERS.FULL_BIO: Senior commercial professional with 25 years of delivering profitable growth and developing capabilities in major multinationals and mid-sized private companies. Extensive leadership experience in international sales, distribution, commercial strategy, revenue growth management across diverse categories and multiple global markets. An adept of customer- and shopper-centricity, Andrey's passionate about occasion-based thinking, shopper psychology, and international expansion. He is an expert in route-to-market design and execution, as well as building challenger brands' activity system to secure distribution, drive trial - and ultimately deliver growth ahead of the market.

TEAM_MEMBERS.NAME: Thanasis Tsepisis
TEAM_MEMBERS.TITLE: Executive Leader
TEAM_MEMBERS.SHORT_BIO: A dynamic top executive at Board of Directors level, with substantial international experience leading and growing businesses with full P&L responsibility across B2C and B2B markets.
TEAM_MEMBERS.FULL_BIO: A dynamic top executive, at Board of Directors level, with substantial and varied international experience gained globally. General Management in Consumer, Industrial, Agriculture, Hardware, Retail, Hospitality markets (B2C & B2B segments). Has successfully led and grown businesses with full P/L responsibility and has also turned around underperforming entities. Particular skills in Sales, Marketing, Distribution, Business Development, Brand Management, Logistics, Project Management, Supply Chain, Operations, HR, Finance. Has provided dynamic leadership to companies in SE Asia, India, China, Africa, Middle East. Multinational experience and mind-set. Consistently driving increases in profitability. Managed & grew Global brands.

TEAM_MEMBERS.NAME: Niko Kontoyannis
TEAM_MEMBERS.TITLE: Executive Leader
TEAM_MEMBERS.SHORT_BIO: Commercial and Sales executive with 20+ years of experience across the FMCG and Luxury industries in EMEA.
TEAM_MEMBERS.FULL_BIO: Executive Leader. Commercial and Sales executive with 20+ years of experience across the FMCG and Luxury industries in EMEA.

TEAM_MEMBERS.NAME: Aadil Katyal
TEAM_MEMBERS.TITLE: Executive Leader
TEAM_MEMBERS.SHORT_BIO: An executive leader with over a decade at Procter & Gamble, building deep expertise across distribution, logistics, manufacturing, and market development in the India Subcontinent.
TEAM_MEMBERS.FULL_BIO: An executive leader with over a decade at Procter & Gamble, he built deep expertise across distribution, logistics, manufacturing, and market development in one of the world's most diverse, fragmented, and competitive FMCG landscapes across India Subcontinent. He has navigated trade environments ranging from modern retail to deep traditional trade, e-commerce to the rapidly evolving quick commerce channel - developing the commercial instincts that bring rigour to brands seeking meaningful market entry and sustainable scale. Pairing sharp commercial acumen with on-ground operational depth, Aadil translates global brand ambition into distributor networks, GTM strategy, and on-ground execution that delivers lasting results.

TEAM_MEMBERS.NAME: William Ordonez
TEAM_MEMBERS.TITLE: Commercial & Business Development Lead – LATAM
TEAM_MEMBERS.SHORT_BIO: Strategic commercial leader with 17+ years of experience in sales, driving regional expansion, business transformation, and commercial execution across LATAM.
TEAM_MEMBERS.FULL_BIO: Strategic commercial leader with 17+ year of experience in sales, driving regional expansion, business transformation, and commercial execution across LATAM. Over his corporate career, he has specialized in restructuring business models, optimizing portfolios, and building regional alliances that deliver sustainable growth. Passionate about continuous improvement, he drives commercial growth from end to end—linking distribution strategy, trade marketing, and in-store execution to deliver profitable growth.

TEAM_MEMBERS.NAME: Muhammad Amin
TEAM_MEMBERS.TITLE: Market Lead – Pakistan & Ethiopia
TEAM_MEMBERS.SHORT_BIO: Market Lead for Pakistan and Ethiopia at TTA, with expertise in route-to-market strategy, structured retail distribution, and multinational brand management including Unilever portfolios.
TEAM_MEMBERS.FULL_BIO: Muhammad Amin serves as the Market Lead for Pakistan and Ethiopia at TTA, bringing a wealth of expertise in route-to-market strategy, structured retail distribution, and multinational brand management. Having successfully managed high-profile portfolios for global giants like Unilever, Amin has a proven track record of driving channel growth across complex markets. His experience spans optimizing full-portfolio distributions, leading dedicated account strategies for major retailers and collaborating with global trade networks. Adept at navigating both structured tier-supermarkets and localized trade landscapes, Amin is uniquely qualified to streamline supply chains, maximize market penetration, build brands and effectively scale TTA's footprint across Pakistan and Ethiopia.
